symptom: `alter page` over the MCP backend (Studio Pro 11.12.5) fails for every page inside a folder with `failed to open page for mutation: module not found: <uuid>` — the uuid is the page's parent FOLDER — while the same statement on a module-root page succeeds; `check --references` passes and the trace shows no PED call before the error
cause: `resolvePageUnit` (MCP page mutator) resolved the module with `GetModule(page.ContainerID)`, and a page's ContainerID is its immediate parent, a folder for most Studio Pro pages. The backend already had the folder-aware answer, `moduleNameForContainer` (walks `resolveDocContainer` up the folder chain), used by CreatePage, DeleteConstant, the microflow mutator and others. `UpdateConstant` and `UpdateWorkflow` (CREATE OR MODIFY on a foldered document) and `forgetSessionConstant` / `forgetSessionEnum` (DROP cleanup; silently left the entry registered) had the same direct lookup
insight: When an error says `<kind> not found: <id>` and the id is NOT an id of that kind, it is the caller passing the wrong id — map the id to what it actually is (here a folder) before reading any resolver. For containers: `GetModule(x.ContainerID)` is correct only for a domain model or a folder's own walk; for any other document grep the package for that exact pattern — a folder-aware helper usually already exists and the bug is the call sites that bypass it (this is the MCP-backend recurrence of #976/#1071 in the executor). The modelsdk engine never had it, so running the bug-test MDL without `--mcp` proves nothing about the fix; the evidence is `mdl/backend/mcp/page_mutator_folder_test.go`, whose fake reader returns `module not found: <id>` for any non-module id exactly as the codec does. Control: production change stashed → `OpenPageForMutation: module not found: fPages` plus the three sibling failures. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1593-mcp-alter-page-in-folder.mdl`. Issue #1593
